title: MOC
html:
89 — The Logic of Provability

修订：2026-10-09。合并后现有 380 个数学原子；书籍说明与 meta 导航另计。全部原有文件名和别名保留。

起点：89-df-modal-formula → 89-df-gl-logic → 89-df-gl-frame → 89-lem-gl-finite-countermodel → 89-thm-solovay-theorem。

术语：glossary。输入材料、来源与验证边界：89-book-info。未提供的历史报告不再列作有效导航。

原包已有的通用一阶语义接口

89-df-first-order-formula → 89-df-first-order-semantics → 89-df-primitive-recursive-representation。

该接口已存在于本轮输入包，明确扩展数值签名下的结构、项列求值和满足关系，不替换 PA 专用标准模型语义。本轮没有新建文件；23 个数学条目的内容修补、4 条新增直接依赖及增量用法见 89-book-info。

原包已有的模板与集合论语法基础链

89-df-first-order-formula → 89-df-formula-graph-expansion → 89-df-settheoretic-graph-notation → 89-df-settheoretic-language → 89-df-settheoretic-coded-syntax → 89-lem-settheoretic-coded-syntax → 89-df-settheoretic-models。

这一既有链条提供模板展开、纯隶属语言图、内部语法及公理码；不以满足关系定义语法码。本轮进一步在原文件中显式声明模板类型、展开输入签名、登记表参数、调用闭包及有限拓扑选择；无下标接口与既有图公式保持。

本轮修补的编码与参数接口

89-df-function → 89-df-effective-computation → 89-df-godel-numbering／89-df-modal-godel-code：明确函数限制、编码参数及有效签名条件。

89-df-glb-letterless-normal-form → 89-lem-glb-nice-normalization → 89-thm-glb-letterless-normal-form → 89-cor-glb-letterless-truth-decision：固定原正规化算法所用的 presentation 与子句编码。

89-df-bimodal-formula → 89-thm-glb-fixed-point：以结构递归的双模态模态化谓词表达原先的盒作用域条件。

89-df-reflection-principle／89-df-reflection-formula → 89-prop-reflection-hierarchy：固定语言与句法类族，并把层级包含前提量化到全部层。

原书章节导航

以下页码继承自原包；本轮未取得 PDF，未重新核验页码换算。下面为章节主题阅读路径；真实直接依赖以各原子 frontmatter 为准，不表示每章所有证明已经逐原子展开。第 10 章现含独立真值树证明链；第 16 章含不动点接口、双模态无字母正规形和分析翻译。深层证明的展开边界见各原子 Remark。

1. GL 的语法与公理（pp.1–14）

89-df-modal-formula → 89-df-normal-modal-logic → 89-df-gl-logic → 89-thm-substitution-lemma-gl → 89-lem-gl-normal → 89-thm-gl-consistency

有限证明与闭包：89-df-gl-proof-system → 89-df-gl-derivable → 89-lem-gl-proof-closure → 89-df-gl-theorem。

一般替换：89-lem-normal-replacement → 89-lem-k4-internal-replacement → 89-lem-modalized-replacement。普通 DNF：89-df-gl-normal-form → 89-lem-gl-decomposition → 89-lem-gl-normal-form。

2. PA、编码与派生条件（pp.15–50）

89-df-arithmetical-language → 89-df-arithmetical-proof-calculus → 89-df-peano-arithmetic → 89-df-provability-predicate → 89-df-sigma-one-formula → 89-thm-sigma-one-completeness → 89-thm-pa-derivability-conditions

3. 盒作为 Bew、Löb 与 GLS（pp.51–67）

89-df-arithmetical-interpretation → 89-thm-generalized-diagonal-lemma → 89-thm-lob-internal → 89-thm-lob-theorem → 89-df-reflection-principle → 89-df-gls-logic

4. 关系语义与 GL 框架（pp.68–77）

89-df-satisfaction-modal → 89-df-converse-well-founded → 89-df-gl-frame → 89-prop-gl-characteristic-frame → 89-prop-converse-wf-transitive → 89-ex-nested-box-edge-extension

5. 有限完全性与判定（pp.78–84）

89-lem-gl-finite-countermodel → 89-df-gl-algorithm → 89-thm-gl-decidable → 89-thm-gl-tree-completeness

自然数输入的判定接口：89-df-modal-godel-code → 89-df-gl-decidability → 89-thm-gl-decidability。

6. 局部一致性与典范模型（pp.85–91）

89-df-modal-consistent-set → 89-df-local-modal-consequence → 89-lem-local-modal-deduction → 89-lem-maximal-consistent-properties → 89-lem-lindenbaum-modal → 89-df-canonical-model → 89-lem-canonical-successor → 89-lem-canonical-truth → 89-thm-canonical-model

收敛：89-df-modal-iteration → 89-lem-canonical-relation-powers → 89-df-convergent-frame → 89-thm-canonical-convergence → 89-thm-convergence-completeness。边界：89-prop-gl-canonical-transitive、89-ex-gl-canonical-reflexive-world。

7. 无字母公式与秩迹（pp.92–103）

89-df-letterless-formula → 89-df-finite-frame-rank → 89-lem-finite-rank-successors → 89-df-letterless-trace → 89-lem-letterless-trace-code → 89-thm-letterless-rank-trace → 89-df-letterless-normal-form → 89-thm-letterless-normal-form → 89-cor-letterless-arithmetical-decision

不紧性：89-ex-gl-incompactness。

8. 模态不动点（pp.104–123）

判据与唯一性：89-df-fixed-point → 89-lem-bernardi-uniqueness → 89-lem-fixed-point-uniqueness；89-lem-modalized-valuation-locality → 89-lem-goldfarb-fixed-point → 89-lem-fixed-point-strong-equivalence。

一般有限构造：89-df-modal-degree → 89-df-modal-characters → 89-lem-modal-character-partition → 89-lem-fixed-point-character-bound → 89-df-fixed-point-algorithm → 89-thm-fixed-point-degree-bound → 89-thm-fixed-point-theorem → 89-thm-fixed-point-characterization。

单字母构造：89-df-single-letter-fixed-trace → 89-lem-single-letter-trace-stability → 89-lem-single-letter-trace-semantics → 89-df-single-letter-fixed-algorithm → 89-thm-single-letter-fixed-point。

第三种存在证明：89-df-inseparable-pair → 89-lem-inseparable-extension → 89-lem-inseparable-box-witness → 89-thm-craig-interpolation → 89-thm-beth-definability → 89-thm-fixed-point-beth。

例子与边界：89-ex-fixed-point-computation、89-ex-fixed-point-degree-increase、89-prop-nonmodalized-fixed-points、89-ex-fixed-point-table-erratum、89-ex-godel-sentence-modal、89-ex-henkin-sentence-modal。练习展开：89-lem-fixed-point-valuation、89-thm-double-fixed-point。

9. GL、GLS 及统一算术完全性（pp.124–137）

89-lem-solovay-self-reference → 89-lem-solovay-limit-properties → 89-lem-solovay-truth → 89-lem-solovay-lem2 → 89-thm-solovay-theorem → 89-df-reflection-companion → 89-thm-gls-completeness → 89-cor-gls-decidable → 89-thm-uniform-solovay-realization

10. 带窗口真值树、完全性与判定（pp.138–147）

89-df-gl-tableau → 89-df-gl-tableau-characteristic → 89-lem-gl-tableau-window → 89-df-gl-tableau-procedure → 89-lem-gl-tableau-termination → 89-lem-gl-tableau-closed-soundness → 89-lem-gl-tableau-open-countermodel → 89-thm-gl-tableau-decision

反模型：89-ex-gl-tableau-countermodel。命题优先条件及旧任意次序的反例：89-ex-gl-tableau-order。关系树与高度界：89-thm-gl-tree-completeness。K 的补充：89-lem-k-acyclic-countermodel → 89-thm-k-lob-rule。

11. Kripke 不完全的模态系统（pp.148–154）

89-df-henkin-modal-logic → 89-lem-henkin-frame-correspondence → 89-thm-henkin-kripke-incomplete

89-ex-cresswell-henkin-model 给出 H 不证明 4 的具体见证。

12. Grz 与 dotted 翻译（pp.155–164）

89-df-grz-logic → 89-df-dotted-translation → 89-df-grz-frame → 89-thm-grz-frame-completeness → 89-thm-grz-translation

13. 集合论中的模态逻辑（pp.165–176）

89-df-finite-prewellorder → 89-df-settheoretic-modal-logics → 89-df-settheoretic-realization → 89-thm-settheoretic-completeness

14. 分析与完整 omega 规则（pp.177–186）

89-df-omega-rule → 89-df-analysis-omega-theory → 89-thm-analysis-omega-completeness

15. 一致性、omega 一致性与 GLB（pp.187–207）

89-df-omega-consistency → 89-df-omega-provability → 89-df-bimodal-formula → 89-df-glb-logic → 89-df-bimodal-arithmetical-realization → 89-thm-glb-arithmetical-completeness → 89-thm-glb-kripke-incomplete → 89-df-glsb-logic → 89-thm-glsb-truth-completeness

GLP（p.207）：89-df-polymodal-formula → 89-df-glp-logic → 89-df-glsp-logic → 89-lem-glp-finite-support；与 GLB 的连接见 89-prop-glb-glp-embedding。

16. GLB 不动点、无字母正规形与分析（pp.208–218）

不动点：89-thm-glb-fixed-point。

序数与公式：89-df-small-ordinal-code → 89-lem-small-ordinal-operations → 89-df-glb-ordinal-formulas → 89-lem-glb-box-absorption → 89-lem-glb-ordinal-comparison → 89-lem-glb-ordinal-truncation。

正规化：89-df-glb-letterless-normal-form → 89-lem-glb-nice-normalization → 89-lem-glb-second-box-boolean → 89-lem-glb-normal-box-reduction → 89-thm-glb-letterless-normal-form → 89-cor-glb-letterless-truth-decision。算例：89-ex-glb-normal-form-reduction。

分析：89-df-bimodal-analysis-realization → 89-thm-glb-analysis-completeness。

17. 量化可证明性逻辑（pp.219–241）

89-df-qml-formula → 89-df-open-provability-formula → 89-df-qml-realization → 89-df-qml-validity-sets → 89-df-relative-completeness → 89-thm-qml-complexity → 89-cor-qml-not-axiomatizable

18. 单一一元谓词片段（pp.242–255）

89-df-one-predicate-qml → 89-thm-one-predicate-complexity
